# Frosted aurora — Style Prompt

> A near-black stage with three dim aurora pools of one colour family drifting slowly behind; thin, light type rises out of blur letter by letter, frosted glass cards with hairline edges float up with a sheen crossing them, a main-to-accent gradient sweeps through the one key word, and between chapters the whole frame fogs over and clears. Premium, transparent and quiet, like a product launch stage talk: one thing moves at a time and every scene ends on a still, readable frame.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The film is **one dark room lit from behind by aurora**. The light stays in the background: three large, soft pools (indigo top left, violet middle right, teal bottom left) orbit slowly and never touch the text directly, and the top-right corner stays bare ground, a dark wedge that gives the frame its depth. On top, the content is sparse and centred on a few type roles: a chapter card (number, light title, a short gradient rule, a mono label), a headline with a numbered list of glass cards, and one giant figure that counts. Text arrives out of blur and leaves by dispersing into blur; scenes are joined by a frost, never by a cut.

Not a rainbow gradient wall (the pools are one family: main colour, accent and the mix between them). Not neon (pools are dim and desaturated toward the ground; nothing glows on the text). Not glassmorphism with thick borders and drop shadows (one hairline at most 16% opacity, no shadow). Not a busy feature grid (one scene, one idea, at most three cards). Not flat: without the grain the pools band into steps.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Ground**: `--latar`, near black, flat. Everything else is laid over it.
- **Aurora pools**: three circles drawn as radial gradients with a long falloff (solid to 28% of the radius, 72% at half, 30% at 68%, 8% at 84%, clear at the edge), which reads like a disc blurred by about 110 px. At 1080×1920: indigo 1600 px wide centred near (200, 500), violet 1800 px centred near (850, 1300), teal 1520 px centred near (240, 1720), stacked in that order so teal sits on top. They are only moved by transforms; nothing is blurred live.
- **Grain**: a 192 px tile of specks, half in `--teks`, half in `--latar`, alpha up to 12% (the product of two randoms, so most specks are faint), drawn once into a full-frame canvas over the pools and under the text. It keeps the gradients from banding and adds film texture without lifting the blacks.
- **Glass cards**: radius 34 px, padding 30 × 38 px, 24 px apart, full content width. Fill: `--teks` at 6% fading to 4% top to bottom, over 40% of the violet pool colour (glass takes the colour behind it); a 1 px inset hairline in `--teks` at 14%; no shadow. A sheen (a 110° band, `--teks` 26% at its core, 60% of the card wide) crosses each card once as it lands.
- **Chapter rule**: 220 × 2 px, centred, gradient from the main colour through the accent to transparent.
- **Tag**: bottom left, fixed through the film: a mono label, a name with a small secondary word in the figure face, and six 34 px swatch dots (ground, text, main, accent, two pools) ringed by the hairline.
- **Frost**: a full-frame layer of `--latar` at 35% with a faint 5% `--teks` haze; under it the tag blurs 6 px and dims to 40%. The source used a 48 px backdrop blur; over an aurora that is already soft, the dimming and the tag's blur are what the eye reads.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar`: the ground, the bare top-right wedge, the dark half of the grain, the first swatch.
- `--utama`: the signal colour (cyan in the example's own colours). It seeds the teal pool, starts and ends the gradient sweep, starts the chapter rule, and colours the card index through `--utama-di-latar`.
- `--aksen`: the second signal (lilac). It seeds the violet pool and, mixed 73/27 with the main colour, the indigo pool; it is the middle of the gradient sweep and the rule.
- **Pools**: each seed is mixed into a grey copy of the ground (`oklab(from var(--latar) l 0 0)`, so the ground's own tint does not bend the hue) at 20% (indigo, teal) or 30% (violet), then its chroma is lifted with `oklch(from … l calc(c * k) h)`: ×4.2 indigo, ×2.8 violet, ×2 teal. On a dark ground that gives dim but deep colour (own values about #1d194f, #36156d, #032c37); on a light ground the same rule gives pastel pools and the look turns into pale frosted glass.
- `--teks`: every reading text, the figures, the glass fill and hairlines, the light half of the grain. `--teks-redup`: mono labels and the small word in the tag.
- Words coloured on the ground (the swept key word, the card index) use `--utama-di-latar` and `--aksen-di-latar`, never `--utama` or `--aksen` directly; on a pale brand they fall back to the text colour and the sweep becomes plain text, still readable.
- `--latar-2` is the solid panel for when glass would not read (over footage or a busy photo); `--teks-di-utama` and `--teks-di-aksen` are for a pill or button filled with the main colour or accent. The example uses neither.
- Nothing is fixed: every colour of the look follows the brand.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries the light titles: chapter title 132 px, scene headline 90 px, the action line under a figure 80 px, the tag name 50 px. Weight 400 (Inter 400 in the example), tracking −0.01em, line height 1.04, balanced lines. Thin type is the look: never a heavy weight for titles.
- `--font-isi` carries the body: card text 58 px, the note under a figure 44 px, weight 400.
- Figures use a look token, `--font-angka`, Space Grotesk 500: the chapter number 180 px (tracking −0.04em, line height 0.9), the hero figure 300 px (tracking −0.05em, tabular), with a small prefix or suffix (Rp, rb, %) at 0.32em hung on the cap line. When the brand's headline face has strong figures, point `--font-angka` at `var(--font-judul)`.
- Labels use `--font-label`, IBM Plex Mono 400: 26 px, uppercase, tracking 0.28em, in `--teks-redup`; the card index 30 px in the main colour; the tag label 22 px at 0.2em.
- When the brand has no fonts: Inter 400 or Poppins 500 for titles, Inter 400 for body, Space Grotesk 500 for figures. A wider brand font may wrap a chapter title onto two lines; do not shrink it below 110 px.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Blur-rise (enter)**: blur 14 px → 0, y +28 px → 0, opacity 0 → 1, 0.85 s `power2.out`. The chapter number and titles per letter, 0.03 s apart, capped so a whole line has started within 0.4 s; labels, the action line and notes per word (cheaper, and small text reads the same); lines 0.1 s apart. The filter is dropped (`none`) the moment a unit lands.
- **Disperse (exit)**: whole blocks at once, opacity → 0, scale 1.04, blur 14 px, 0.35 s `power2.in`.
- **Gradient sweep (emphasis)**: the key word turns into a 100° gradient (main 0%, accent 45%, main 90%, 260% wide) whose position runs 100% → 0% in 0.9 s `power2.inOut`. Once per scene, about 1 s after its headline lands.
- **Glass cards (list)**: each card rises from y +44 px, scale 0.96, blur 12 px in 0.85 s `power2.out`, 0.8 s apart; its sheen crosses in 1.1 s `power2.inOut` starting 0.1 s after the card.
- **Soft-count (number)**: the figure comes out of blur 12 px and y +20 px in 0.7 s `power2.out` while it counts from 0 in 1.4 s `expo.out`; the action line rises about 0.9 s later, the note 0.25 s after that.
- **Rule**: scales from the centre, 0 → 1 in 0.5 s `power2.out`, 0.35 s after the title starts.
- **Frost (transition)**: covers in 0.4 s `power2.in`, clears in 0.5 s `power2.out`; the next scene starts rising as it clears, so the frame is never empty for more than half a second.
- **Ambient**: pools orbit on sines with periods near 3.2, 4.1 and 5.0 s (rounded so they fit the film), back and forth, offsets of 60-130 px across and 80-150 px down, scale 1 → 1.15. That breathing is the push: the text layer itself never scales.
- **Holds**: the chapter card holds about 2 s once built, the list about 3 s after its last card, the ending at least 2 s with nothing but the pools moving.

## 6. Camera grammar

The camera does not move: the light does. (The source pushed the whole frame 1 → 1.03 over the film; here the pools' own breathing carries that slow push, because scaling the text or the pool container makes the live preview repaint every frame.)

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Breathing light: each pool scales 1 → 1.15 and drifts on its own 3-5 s sine while the text holds still | calm attention, patience, a premium pace | every scene |
| Frost: the frame fogs and clears in 0.9 s | a breath between chapters: same room, next topic | every scene change |
| Pools sliding past the bare top-right wedge | depth: the room is larger than the frame | openers, long holds, endings |
| Stillness after the count lands | the answer has arrived | number, payoff, cta |

No cuts, no whip pans, no zoom punches, no shakes.

## 7. Native moves

- **Chapter card.** A number and a light title rise out of blur letter by letter, a short gradient rule opens from the centre under them, a mono label settles last. *Fits content like:* "01 Bima Sakti" opening lesson one of a phone astrophotography class; a new phone case line introduced as chapter 02 of a shop's catalogue; a creator's episode number and title; the first chapter of a short story told in three cards.
- **Gradient sweep on the key word.** One word of a still headline fills with the main-to-accent gradient, swept right to left. *Fits content like:* the "3" in "Cukup 3 setelan"; the discount in a skincare launch; the new feature's name in an app update; the twist word in a story's last line.
- **Glass cards rising.** Numbered frosted cards float up one by one, 0.8 s apart, a sheen crossing each as it lands. *Fits content like:* three camera settings; three flavours of a new drink; a course's three modules; three clues in a mystery.
- **Frost transition.** The whole frame fogs over, the old scene dispersing, and clears onto the next. *Fits content like:* moving from the question to the steps; switching from a product's design to its price; a creator's "next" between two tips; a time skip in a story.
- **Soft-count figure.** After a beat of empty aurora, one giant figure comes out of blur while it counts to its value, then an action line and a note rise under it. *Fits content like:* a class price "Rp79rb"; "92%" of buyers who reorder; a channel reaching "120rb" subscribers; the number of nights a story's hero waited.

## 8. Pitfalls

- **Performance (live preview).** Never blur the aurora live (the source blurred the pool layer 110 px every frame): draw soft radial gradients and move them with transforms, each on its own layer. Never scale a container of the pools or of text that is blurring (a whole-frame push repaints everything each frame). No `backdrop-filter`: the frost is a dim layer (`will-change: opacity`) plus a small blur on the tag. Blur only small text units and single cards, and set `filter: none` when they land. Draw the grain once.
- **One colour family.** The pools come from the main colour and accent only; never add a third hue or a rainbow, and keep the top-right corner bare.
- **Light stays behind.** Do not brighten the pools to make the frame "pop"; text must sit on dim colour, and on a pale brand the pools turn pastel so dark text still reads.
- **Thin type, real sizes.** Keep titles light but large; body text never under 40 px; mono labels are decoration, never the only place information lives.
- **One sweep per scene.** Sweeping several words, or sweeping during the text's rise, turns the accent into noise.
- **Safe zones.** Reading text stays within y 250-1500; the tag sits just above the bottom 420 px (the source set it lower, at 300 px).
- **Relative colour.** The pool tokens use `oklch(from …)` and `oklab(from …)`, supported by current browsers; keep them on `:root` so a brand recolours them by changing only the contract tokens.

## Measured from the references

- Rhythm of the 15 s reference: chapter card built by 1 s and dispersing at 2.75 s; frost 2.85-3.75 s; headline from 3.25 s, sweep at 4.25 s; cards at 5.15, 5.95 and 6.75 s; list held until 9.85 s; frost 9.95-10.85 s; figure counting 10.55-11.95 s; action line, note and sweep by 13 s; still to the end.
- Layout at 1080×1920: 80 px side margins (70 px for the centred chapter card), chapter card top 700 px, headline top 420 px, list top 820 px with a 152 px card pitch, figure top 640 px, centred.
- Colours measured in the reference: ground #09070c, indigo pool core about #1b1255, violet about #38116c, teal about #063138; a glass card about 10% lighter than the pool behind it.

# Frosted aurora: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.8, medium 4, long 6.

## hook

- en: chapter card: number and light title rise out of blur letter by letter, a gradient rule opens from the centre, a mono label
- id: kartu bab: nomor dan judul tipis naik dari blur huruf demi huruf, garis gradien terbuka dari tengah, label mono

## problem

- en: the pain as one light headline rising out of blur over the aurora; its key word fills with the main-to-accent gradient
- id: masalahnya satu judul tipis yang naik dari blur di atas aurora; kata kuncinya terisi gradien warna utama ke aksen

## fact

- en: mono kicker and a light headline at the top, held still; one key word takes the gradient sweep
- id: label mono dan judul tipis di atas, lalu diam; satu kata kunci disapu gradien

## step

- en: frosted glass cards rise out of blur one by one, 0.8 s apart, a light sheen crossing each; index in the main colour
- id: kartu kaca buram naik dari blur satu per satu, jeda 0,8 detik, kilau cahaya melintas; nomor berwarna utama

## compare

- en: two glass cards, each with its figure counting softly; the winner's figure takes the gradient sweep
- id: dua kartu kaca, masing-masing dengan angka yang menghitung pelan; angka pemenang disapu gradien

## number

- en: after a frost, one giant figure fades in from blur while it counts up; unit and note rise after it
- id: setelah kabut, satu angka raksasa muncul dari blur sambil menghitung naik; satuan dan catatan menyusul

## proof

- en: a short quote in a glass card rising out of blur, the name in a mono label; one word swept by the gradient
- id: kutipan pendek di kartu kaca yang naik dari blur, nama dalam label mono; satu kata disapu gradien

## offer

- en: the offer as a light headline with its key word swept by the gradient, the price counting in below
- id: penawaran jadi judul tipis dengan kata kunci disapu gradien, harga menghitung masuk di bawahnya

## cta

- en: the price counts in from blur, the action in light type under it, the contact's number swept by the gradient; held 2 s
- id: harga menghitung masuk dari blur, ajakan dengan huruf tipis di bawahnya, nomor kontak disapu gradien; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the one figure that answers the hook counts in from blur; unit and note rise, one word swept; held 2 s
- id: angka yang menjawab pembuka menghitung masuk dari blur; satuan dan catatan menyusul, satu kata disapu; diam 2 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Kaca aurora</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Space Grotesk"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #07070c; --latar-2: #18181e; --utama: #62dcff; --aksen: #a98bff;
        --teks: #f5f5fa; --teks-redup: #a2a2b8; --teks-di-utama: #07070c; --teks-di-aksen: #07070c;
        --utama-di-latar: #62dcff; --aksen-di-latar: #a98bff;
        --font-judul: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Milik tampilan ini: angka Space Grotesk, label mono. */
        --font-angka: "Space Grotesk", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        --font-label: "IBM Plex Mono", "Noto Sans", monospace;
        /* Tiga gumpal aurora, satu keluarga warna dari utama ke aksen: dicampur ke latar yang dibuat abu (rona tetap
           milik brand), lalu chroma diangkat; di latar gelap redup tapi pekat, di latar terang jadi pastel. */
        --latar-abu: oklab(from var(--latar) l 0 0);
        --kabut-nila: oklch(from color-mix(in oklab, color-mix(in oklab, var(--aksen) 73%, var(--utama)) 20%, var(--latar-abu)) l calc(c * 4.2) h);
        --kabut-ungu: oklch(from color-mix(in oklab, var(--aksen) 30%, var(--latar-abu)) l calc(c * 2.8) h);
        --kabut-toska: oklch(from color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 20%, var(--latar-abu)) l calc(c * 2) h);
        /* Kaca buram: isi 6% teks di atas sedikit warna aurora (kaca menyerap warna di belakangnya), tepi rambut 14%. */
        --kaca: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 6%, transparent);
        --tepi: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 14%, transparent);
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar);
        color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
      .lap { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
      /* Gumpal aurora: lingkaran gradien bertepi lembut (pengganti blur 110 px), hanya digeser transform. */
      .gumpal { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; will-change: transform;
        background: radial-gradient(closest-side, var(--c) 0%, var(--c) 28%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 72%, transparent) 50%,
          color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 30%, transparent) 68%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 8%, transparent) 84%, transparent 100%); }
      #g1 { --c: var(--kabut-nila); left: -600px; top: -300px; width: 1600px; height: 1600px; }
      #g2 { --c: var(--kabut-ungu); left: -50px; top: 400px; width: 1800px; height: 1800px; }
      #g3 { --c: var(--kabut-toska); left: -520px; top: 960px; width: 1520px; height: 1520px; }
      /* Butir film digambar sekali di kanvas (lihat skrip), diam di atas aurora. */
      #butir { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      .wd { display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap; }
      .ch { display: inline-block; white-space: pre; }
      .lbl { font-family: var(--font-label); font-weight: 400; font-size: 26px; letter-spacing: 0.28em;
        text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .jdl { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.04; text-wrap: balance; }
      /* Kata kunci: gradien utama → aksen disapu lewat --gp (gradient-sweep). */
      em { font-style: normal; display: inline-block; }
      em[data-grad="1"] { background-image: linear-gradient(100deg, var(--utama-di-latar) 0%, var(--aksen-di-latar) 45%, var(--utama-di-latar) 90%);
        background-size: 260% 100%; background-position: var(--gp, 0%) 0%; -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }

      /* Adegan 1: kartu bab di tengah. */
      #pembuka { position: absolute; left: 70px; right: 70px; top: 700px; text-align: center; }
      #pembuka .num { font-family: var(--font-angka); font-weight: 500; font-size: 180px; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.04em; }
      #pembuka .ttl { margin-top: 26px; font-size: 132px; }
      #pembuka .garis { margin: 26px auto 0; width: 220px; height: 2px;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--utama-di-latar), var(--aksen-di-latar), transparent); }
      #pembuka .lbl { margin-top: 30px; }
      /* Adegan 2: judul di atas, kartu kaca bernomor. */
      #kepala { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 420px; }
      #kepala .ttl { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 90px; }
      #daftar { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 820px; list-style: none; }
      #daftar li { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 28px; padding: 30px 38px; margin-bottom: 24px;
        border-radius: 34px; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--kaca), color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 4%, transparent)),
          color-mix(in oklab, var(--kabut-ungu) 40%, transparent);
        box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--tepi); }
      #daftar .idx { font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 30px; min-width: 70px; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      #daftar .txt { font-size: 58px; line-height: 1.1; }
      /* Kilau: pita cahaya miring yang melintas sekali di kartu. */
      #daftar .kilau { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 60%; will-change: transform;
        background: linear-gradient(110deg, transparent 20%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 26%, transparent) 50%, transparent 80%); }
      /* Adegan 3: satu angka besar di tengah; awalan dan satuan kecil menempel di atas. */
      #angka { position: absolute; left: 100px; right: 100px; top: 640px; text-align: center; }
      #angka .val { font-family: var(--font-angka); font-weight: 500; font-size: 300px; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.05em;
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
      #angka .val small { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.32em; letter-spacing: 0; vertical-align: top; line-height: 1; padding-top: 0.12em; }
      #angka .val small:first-child { margin-right: 0.06em; }
      #angka .val small:last-child { margin-left: 0.04em; }
      #angka .unit { margin-top: 18px; font-size: 80px; }
      #angka .note { margin-top: 72px; font-size: 44px; }
      /* Penanda tetap kiri bawah: label mono, nama, enam titik warna (enam sesi). */
      #tanda { position: absolute; left: 80px; bottom: 420px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
      #tanda .lbl { font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; }
      #tanda .n { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 50px; line-height: 1.1; }
      #tanda .n small { margin-left: 16px; font-family: var(--font-angka); font-weight: 500; font-size: 30px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      #titik { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 6px; }
      #titik i { display: block; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--tepi); }
      #titik i:nth-child(1) { background: var(--latar); }
      #titik i:nth-child(2) { background: var(--teks); }
      #titik i:nth-child(3) { background: var(--utama); }
      #titik i:nth-child(4) { background: var(--aksen); }
      #titik i:nth-child(5) { background: var(--kabut-nila); }
      #titik i:nth-child(6) { background: var(--kabut-ungu); }
      /* Embun pindah adegan: layar meredup 35% ke latar dengan kabut tipis, lalu bening lagi (pengganti backdrop blur 48 px). */
      #embun { opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; will-change: opacity;
        background: radial-gradient(80% 50% at 40% 45%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 5%, transparent), transparent 75%),
          color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 35%, transparent); }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div class="lap" id="langit"><i class="gumpal" id="g1"></i><i class="gumpal" id="g2"></i><i class="gumpal" id="g3"></i></div>
      <canvas class="lap" id="butir" width="1080" height="1920"></canvas>

      <div class="lap" id="panggung">
        <section class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook"><!-- Adegan 1, pembuka: nomor dan judul naik dari blur huruf demi huruf, garis gradien, label mono. -->
          <div id="pembuka">
            <div class="num">01</div>
            <div class="ttl jdl">Bima Sakti</div>
            <div class="garis"></div>
            <div class="lbl">Kelas foto malam · pakai HP</div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="scene" id="s2" data-role="step"><!-- Adegan 2, langkah: angka kunci disapu gradien, kartu kaca naik satu per satu dengan kilau. -->
          <div id="kepala">
            <div class="lbl">Setelan kamera HP</div>
            <div class="ttl jdl">Cukup <em id="kunci">3</em> setelan</div>
          </div>
          <ul id="daftar">
            <li><span class="idx">01</span><span class="txt">ISO 1600</span><i class="kilau"></i></li>
            <li><span class="idx">02</span><span class="txt">Rana 15 detik</span><i class="kilau"></i></li>
            <li><span class="idx">03</span><span class="txt">Fokus tak hingga</span><i class="kilau"></i></li>
          </ul>

        const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
        const $$ = (s) => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(s));
        // PRNG berbiji (mulberry32): butir dan orbit aurora sama di pratinjau dan render.
        let seed = 13;
        const acak = () => {
          seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
          let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
          t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
          return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
        };
        const MASUK = 0.85, KELUAR = 0.35;

        // Butir: ubin 192 px berbintik warna --teks dan --latar (terang dan gelap seimbang, latar tidak terangkat),
        // digambar sekali lalu diulang memenuhi kanvas.
        const ubin = document.createElement("canvas");
        ubin.width = ubin.height = 192;
        const cu = ubin.getContext("2d");
        const warna = ["--teks", "--latar"].map((t, i) => {
          cu.fillStyle = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(t).trim();
          cu.fillRect(i, 0, 1, 1);
          return cu.getImageData(i, 0, 1, 1).data;
        });
        const img = cu.createImageData(192, 192);
        for (let i = 0; i < img.data.length; i += 4) {
          const w = warna[acak() < 0.5 ? 0 : 1];
          img.data[i] = w[0]; img.data[i + 1] = w[1]; img.data[i + 2] = w[2];
          img.data[i + 3] = Math.floor(acak() * acak() * 32);
        }
        cu.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
        const cb = $("#butir").getContext("2d");
        cb.fillStyle = cb.createPattern(ubin, "repeat");
        cb.fillRect(0, 0, 1080, 1920);

        // Pecah teks jadi huruf (nomor dan judul) atau kata (label, satuan, catatan: lebih ringan); <em> tetap satu unit.
        function pecah(el, huruf) {
          const unit = [];
          const walk = (node) => [...node.childNodes].forEach((c) => {
            if (c.nodeType === 1) return c.tagName === "EM" ? void unit.push(c) : walk(c);
            if (c.nodeType !== 3) return;
            const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
            for (const tok of c.textContent.split(/(\s+)/)) {
              if (!tok) continue;
              if (/^\s+$/.test(tok)) { frag.append(tok); continue; }
              const w = Object.assign(document.createElement("span"), { className: "wd" });
              if (huruf) for (const h of tok) unit.push(w.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement("span"), { className: "ch", textContent: h })));
              else { w.textContent = tok; unit.push(w); }
              frag.append(w);
            }
            c.replaceWith(frag);
          });
          walk(el);
          return unit;

          const u = pecah(el, huruf);
          const stg = Math.min(0.03, 0.4 / Math.max(1, u.length - 1));
          tl.fromTo(u, { autoAlpha: 0, y: 28, filter: "blur(14px)" }, { autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)", duration: MASUK, ease: "power2.out", stagger: stg }, t);
          tl.set(u, { filter: "none" }, t + MASUK + stg * (u.length - 1));

          tl.set(li, { filter: "none" }, t + MASUK);
          tl.fromTo(li.querySelector(".kilau"), { xPercent: -110 }, { xPercent: 180, duration: 1.1, ease: "power2.inOut" }, t + 0.1);

        function hitung(val, angka, t) {
          const akhir = Number(angka.textContent), o = { v: 0 };
          let tampil = null;
          const tulis = () => { const v = Math.round(o.v); if (v !== tampil) angka.textContent = tampil = v; };
          tl.fromTo(val, { autoAlpha: 0, y: 20, filter: "blur(12px)" }, { autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)", duration: 0.7, ease: "power2.out" }, t);
          tl.set(val, { filter: "none" }, t + 0.7);
          tl.fromTo(o, { v: 0 }, { v: akhir, duration: 1.4, ease: "expo.out", onUpdate: tulis }, t);

        // yang sedang blur: lapisannya digambar ulang tiap frame. Tiap gumpal mengorbit pelan (sine, periode ±3,2 / 4,1 / 5,0 dtk, bolak-balik, skala 1 → 1,15).
        $$(".gumpal").forEach((el, i) => {

          tl.fromTo(el, { x: (acak() - 0.5) * 120, y: (acak() - 0.5) * 160, scale: 1 },

        });

        naik($("#pembuka .ttl"), 0.1);
        tl.fromTo("#pembuka .garis", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out" }, 0.45);
        naik($("#pembuka .lbl"), 0.4, false);
        buyar($$("#pembuka > *"), 2.75);

        const cb = $("#butir").getContext("2d");
        cb.fillStyle = cb.createPattern(ubin, "repeat");
        cb.fillRect(0, 0, 1920, 1080);

        // Pecah teks jadi huruf (nomor dan judul) atau kata (label, satuan, catatan: lebih ringan); <em> tetap satu unit.
        function pecah(el, huruf) {
          const unit = [];
          const walk = (node) => [...node.childNodes].forEach((c) => {
            if (c.nodeType === 1) return c.tagName === "EM" ? void unit.push(c) : walk(c);
            if (c.nodeType !== 3) return;
            const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
            for (const tok of c.textContent.split(/(\s+)/)) {
              if (!tok) continue;
              if (/^\s+$/.test(tok)) { frag.append(tok); continue; }
              const w = Object.assign(document.createElement("span"), { className: "wd" });
              if (huruf) for (const h of tok) unit.push(w.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement("span"), { className: "ch", textContent: h })));
              else { w.textContent = tok; unit.push(w); }
              frag.append(w);
            }
            c.replaceWith(frag);
          });
          walk(el);
          return unit;
        }
        // blur-rise: blur 14 px + naik 28 px → tajam, 0,85 dtk power2.out, 0,03 dtk per unit (satu baris masuk ≤ 0,4 dtk).
        function naik(el, t, huruf = true) {
          const u = pecah(el, huruf);
          const stg = Math.min(0.03, 0.4 / Math.max(1, u.length - 1));
          tl.fromTo(u, { autoAlpha: 0, y: 28, filter: "blur(14px)" }, { autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)", duration: MASUK, ease: "power2.out", stagger: stg }, t);
          tl.set(u, { filter: "none" }, t + MASUK + stg * (u.length - 1));
        }
        // disperse: pudar sambil membesar 1,04 dan memburam 14 px, 0,35 dtk power2.in.
        const buyar = (els, t) => tl.fromTo(els, { filter: "blur(0px)" }, { autoAlpha: 0, scale: 1.04, filter: "blur(14px)", duration: KELUAR, ease: "power2.in", immediateRender: false }, t);
        // gradient-sweep: kata kunci jadi gradien utama → aksen yang disapu kanan ke kiri, 0,9 dtk power2.inOut.
        function sapu(el, t) {
          tl.set(el, { attr: { "data-grad": "1" } }, t);
          tl.fromTo(el, { "--gp": "100%" }, { "--gp": "0%", duration: 0.9, ease: "power2.inOut", immediateRender: false }, t);
        }
        // frost: layar memburam 0,4 dtk power2.in, bening 0,5 dtk power2.out; penanda ikut kabur dan redup.
        function embun(t) {
          tl.fromTo("#embun", { autoAlpha: 0 }, { autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: "power2.in", immediateRender: false }, t);
          tl.to("#embun", { autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out" }, t + 0.42);
          tl.fromTo("#tanda", { opacity: 1, filter: "blur(0px)" }, { opacity: 0.4, filter: "blur(6px)", duration: 0.4, ease: "power2.in", immediateRender: false }, t);
          tl.to("#tanda", { opacity: 1, filter: "blur(0px)", duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out" }, t + 0.42);
          tl.set("#tanda", { filter: "none" }, t + 0.93);
          return t + 0.4;
        }
        // glass-cards: kartu naik dari blur (44 px, 0,96 → 1), kilau melintas 1,1 dtk sejak 0,1 dtk kemudian.
        function kartu(li, t) {
          tl.fromTo(li, { autoAlpha: 0, y: 44, scale: 0.96, filter: "blur(12px)" }, { autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, scale: 1, filter: "blur(0px)", duration: MASUK, ease: "power2.out" }, t);
          tl.set(li, { filter: "none" }, t + MASUK);
          tl.fromTo(li.querySelector(".kilau"), { xPercent: -110 }, { xPercent: 180, duration: 1.1, ease: "power2.inOut" }, t + 0.1);
        }
        // soft-count: angka muncul dari blur 12 px (0,7 dtk) sambil menghitung dari 0, 1,4 dtk expo.out.
        function hitung(val, angka, t) {
          const akhir = Number(angka.textContent), o = { v: 0 };
          let tampil = null;
          const tulis = () => { const v = Math.round(o.v); if (v !== tampil) angka.textContent = tampil = v; };
          tl.fromTo(val, { autoAlpha: 0, y: 20, filter: "blur(12px)" }, { autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, filter: "blur(0px)", duration: 0.7, ease: "power2.out" }, t);
          tl.set(val, { filter: "none" }, t + 0.7);
          tl.fromTo(o, { v: 0 }, { v: akhir, duration: 1.4, ease: "expo.out", onUpdate: tulis }, t);
        }

        // Kamera diam; yang bergerak cahayanya (skala gumpal = dorongan pelan). Jangan menskala wadah gumpal atau teks
        // yang sedang blur: lapisannya digambar ulang tiap frame. Tiap gumpal mengorbit pelan (sine, periode ±3,2 / 4,1 / 5,0 dtk, bolak-balik, skala 1 → 1,15).
        $$(".gumpal").forEach((el, i) => {
          const n = Math.round(15 / (3.2 + i * 0.9)); // periode dibulatkan supaya pas 15 dtk
          tl.fromTo(el, { x: (acak() - 0.5) * 120, y: (acak() - 0.5) * 160, scale: 1 },
            { x: (acak() - 0.5) * 260, y: (acak() - 0.5) * 300, scale: 1.15, duration: 15 / n, yoyo: true, repeat: n - 1, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 0);
        });

        // ===== 1. Pembuka (0-3,1): nomor → judul → garis dari tengah → label =====
        naik($("#pembuka .num"), 0);
        naik($("#pembuka .ttl"), 0.1);
        tl.fromTo("#pembuka .garis", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out" }, 0.45);
        naik($("#pembuka .lbl"), 0.4, false);
        buyar($$("#pembuka > *"), 2.75);
        const t2 = embun(2.85);

        // ===== 2. Langkah (3,25-10,2): label + judul, sapuan gradien di angka, tiga kartu kaca =====
        naik($("#kepala .lbl"), t2, false);
        naik($("#kepala .ttl"), t2 + 0.1);
        sapu($("#kunci"), 4.25);
        $$("#daftar li").forEach((li, i) => kartu(li, 5.15 + i * 0.8));
        buyar([...$$("#kepala > *"), ...$$("#daftar li")], 9.85);
        const t3 = embun(9.95);

        // ===== 3. Ajakan (10,35-15): harga menghitung, ajakan, kontak, sapuan di nomor; diam 2 dtk lebih =====
        hitung($("#angka .val"), $("#nilai"), t3 + 0.2);
        naik($("#angka .unit"), 11.45, false);
        naik($("#angka .note"), 11.7, false);
        sapu($("#wa"), 12.0);

        window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
        window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
      })();
    </script>
  </body>
